Eligibility Criteria for B. Tech
Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Eligibility
Candidate should have passed HSC or its equivalent examination with Physics and
Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry or Biology or Biotechnology or
Technical Vocational subject or Electronics or Computer Science or Information
Technology or Informatics Practices or Agriculture or Engineering Graphics or Business
Studies and obtained at least 45% marks (at least 40% marks in case of Backward class
categories, Economically Weaker Section and Persons with Disability candidates
belonging to Maharashtra State only) in the above subjects taken together.
Entrance Examination Requirement
The candidate should have appeared in all the subjects in MHT-CET (PCM) of 2026 and
should have obtained a non-zero score in MHT-CET (PCM) or should have given JEE
Mains of 2026.
Common Documents Required for All Candidates
1. SSC Mark Sheet
2. SSC Certificate
3. HSC/Diploma Mark Sheet
4. HSC Leaving Certificate (TC)
5. MHT-CET 2026 (PCM) or JEE (Mains 2026) Score Card
6. Certificate of Age, Nationality and Domicile or Birth Certificate or Leaving Certificate
showing place of birth in State of Maharashtra
7. Passport size Photograph
